title: Niagara Falls, USA Day & Night Small Group Tour plus Dinner
includes: Complimentary Hotel Pick-up and Drop-off in Niagara Falls, USA or Niagara Falls, Canada
Fully Narrated Guided Small-Group Tour of Niagara Falls
Maid of the Mist Boat Ride (Admission Included)
Dinner at Steak Stone & Sushi Restaurant (Included in Price)
Cave of the Winds Experience (Admission Included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Please note the Maid of the Mist is seasonal, operating May through October. Please call ahead to confirm availability.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This fully guided 7-hour tour of Niagara Falls, NY is perfect for families with children. The tour covers all the highlights of the Falls and includes admission to the Maid of the Mist and the Cave of the Winds (seasonal, May-Oct). Tour narration features an emphasis on storytelling and entertainment. 

Tour includes: 
- A trip aboard the Maid of the Mist to get up close and personal with the Falls (Operating May through October)
- Stop at the American Observation Tower 
- Tour of the Cave of the Winds
- Dinner at Steak Stone & Sushi
- Watch the fireworks and illumination lights on the Falls
- Visit Goat Island where you'll take in amazing views of Horseshoe Falls, American Falls & Bridal Veil Falls
- Small, intimate group tour that consists of approximately 6 people 
- Pick up and drop off at any location in Niagara Falls, NY 
- An energetic tour guide that can answer almost any question you have about the Majestic Falls and surrounding area
